_: Department drawings mapped to LEARN note sections. (1) Line drawings from the owner's uploads CERVICAL FASCIA.pdf and GREAT VESSELS OF THE NECK.pdf and the CNS-levels scans: prepare.py crops them (embedded images, or a y-band of a scanned page). (2) Figures of the Kasr Al Ainy NEU 205 book (205_NEU_Published.pdf, as the owner's 'Labeled Drawings and Pictures' Part PDFs; entries with 'book' = its figure number): prepare_book.py extracts them, including the book's colour plates, since they are part of the official book. Book figures that repeat a drawing already here keep one copy, the sharper; figures left out are listed in docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md. Captions are ours, from the labels on each figure. Both scripts write plain JPEGs into one folder outside the repo; encrypt.mjs writes the encrypted copies to source/public/dept/ and the manifest to source/public/dept-figs-v16-data.js. (3) Dr Sameh Doss's labelled head-and-neck and neuroanatomy drawings (the owner's three PDF parts, 283 notebook pages): prepare_sameh.py cuts each labelled drawing out of its page (the 'box', in percent of the page, is where the drawing is; the handwritten paragraphs around it are left out) and writes plain JPEGs. 'sameh' is the notebook page number, counted in order of first appearance of each distinct page image across the three parts. 'sc' is a relevance score per placement (caption against the section's text, x1.15 for Dr Doss's drawings) used to show the best drawings first. Captions are ours, from the labels on each drawing.
